name: Gunner
description: Loads and fires the broadsides. Better gunners reload faster.

name: Sailor
description: Works the rigging. Keeps the ship fast and able to flee.

name: Helmsman
description: Steers. Higher level makes coming about faster and safer.

name: Carpenter
description: Patches holes and repairs damaged rooms.

name: Boarder
description: First across the rail in a boarding action.
